extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Hillsborough County has a $20 monthly premium, a $290 drug deductible and a $5900 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. However, the agent collected personal information (Medicare number and date of birth) before sending the Scope of Appointment.
composition.coaching_note: The agent did a good job with the call, but it's important to send the Scope of Appointment before collecting sensitive information like Medicare numbers and dates of birth. This ensures that the customer has the opportunity to review the Scope of Appointment and ask questions before providing personal details.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with Mrs. Lindqvist to ensure she has reviewed the Scope of Appointment and confirm the plan details.
